subject: I don't get it... ???
author: ZombieTron
body:
We have had this query before, and I don't get it? What do you mean "play games on here"???

This is a community site for fans of Burnout video games... there are no games to play on the site. You can vote in our Polls, read/write blogs and forum comments and read/comment on our news stories.

What games would you want to play on here?
